policy_summary: Twelve designated council car parks piloted from summer 2022 for self-contained overnight stays, max 24 hours, in allocated bays. Areas: Inverness, Nairn, Caithness, Wick, Sutherland, Wester Ross. Reported at around GBP10 a night or GBP40 a week. Explicitly framed as relieving lay-by pressure on the road network rather than as enforcement - the council notes lay-by overnight parking is not illegal.
open_questions: Which twelve car parks? Areas named, sites not.
Did the pilot become permanent, and has it expanded since 2022?
Sutherland area committee separately moved for a blanket ban in council car parks - what happened to that?

sites.name: Twelve pilot car parks (Inverness, Nairn, Caithness, Wick, Sutherland, Wester Ross)
sites.notes: Max stay 24 hours. Price from secondary reporting - around GBP10/night or GBP40/week. Individual sites not yet identified.
